description:
*Note: This is a promotional oneshot of webnovel.*

Hi. Maybe I'm your first fairy?  
***  
I met a lonely child, very deep underground. I wanted to see the kid smile. So, I was born as a flower fairy.  
"I'll promise. I will get out of here with you!”  
You are a seed trapped in the ground. In the name of the flower fairy, I will surely make you bloom.  
"Yes. Let's work together. Let's go out together … take each other out of here.”  
To escape with the cute boy, the fairy has a lot of work to do! We prepared hard for a long time. And finally, an opportunity, not an opportunity, comes... .  
***  
Finally out into the world. The whole world coveted my human being in full bloom.  
“You are too great for me to have.”  
My first person. My precious planet. My beloved flower. The origin of the fairy Shrensha, Lioren.  
I was going to let rio a little, very little, for rio's life.  
“Ren is the greatest in the world. I’m just Lioren from Shrensha.”  
Rio knew only me.  
“Shrensha, please sign a contract with me.”  
Forever.

Promotional Webtoon/Novel
